title: Arabic, right to left

steps.say: An Arabic report with no language settings. The page still runs left to right, and the figure is labelled in English.
lang: ar and dir: rtl turn the page around: text, headings and the title block now run right to left.
The figure still says Figure. Quarto has no Arabic labels built in; a small language file supplies them, so the caption reads شكل 1.
The same settings carry into the Typst PDF, with an Arabic-capable font from the project's fonts folder.

final:
---
title: "البطالة في المناطق"
lang: ar
dir: rtl
language: _language-ar.yml
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    mainfont: Tajawal
    font-paths: fonts
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
```

انخفض معدل البطالة في معظم المناطق بين 2022 و2025،
وجازان هي الاستثناء.

```{r}
#| label: fig-trend
#| fig-cap: "معدل البطالة في المملكة (%)"
#| echo: false
ggplot(kingdom, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```

يوضح @fig-trend الاتجاه العام في المملكة.
